## TemplateManager.getMessage() method

Gets a compiled message template string.

**Signature:**

```typescript
getMessage(key: string, baseId?: string, language?: string, data?: Record<string, any>): string;
```

**Returns:**

string

Rendered message string, or empty string if not found

## Remarks

Retrieves the compiled message function for the specified template and language, then executes it with the provided data to generate the message.

## Example


```typescript
const message = tm.getMessage("start", "default", "en", {name: "John"})
// => "Hello, John! Welcome to the bot."
```
